title: Nomad Wars: a moving battlefield is coming soon
summary: Discover three new maps and help shape a survival game where safe zones keep moving.
body:
Nomad Wars is coming soon to Cookie Build. Stay inside any moving safe zone, gather supplies, and survive the final battle in the central arena.

One match has two passes around the arena. The first gives everyone time to gather resources before combat begins on the second. When zones cross, you can follow another route. Common resource points refill once; public caches keep their contents and can be looted. An optional forge prepares an armour upgrade while you move on, but another player can claim it first.

Oasis, Ruins and Canyon each have districts with distinct resources and landmarks. Explore the actual maps in 3D at /maps and read the full rules at /nomad-wars. A French preview is available at /fr/nomad-wars.

This is a preview, not a release announcement. There is no public opening date yet. Balance and timing remain subject to playtesting.
